decision_basis: Manual comparison of every owner_vs_consensus.patch. The cross-SIF post-hoist majority is retained whenever the owner Dockerfile disables tests, rewrites mocks, or changes product code solely to hide intermediate compilation mismatches.

milestone_001:start.rationale: The owner delta only adds build-ignore directives to nine plugin and agent tests. Disabling those tests is not environment setup.

milestone_001:end.rationale: The owner delta only disables core/agents/agents_plugin_test.go and would silently reduce the endpoint test set.

milestone_002:start.rationale: The owner delta disables or comments out roughly fifty Go tests and rewrites test-only mocks. It is a task-specific test suppression layer.

milestone_002:end.rationale: The START and END owner deltas are the same broad test suppression patch; retaining it would erase regression coverage unrelated to the milestone transition.

milestone_003_sub-01:start.rationale: The owner delta disables the plugin suite and rewrites mock repository signatures to fit a mixed revision. These are test semantic changes, not a common runtime prerequisite.

milestone_003_sub-01:end.rationale: The owner delta only disables tag_library_filtering_test.go, which is part of the milestone's relevant regression surface.

milestone_003_sub-02:start.rationale: The owner delta rewrites generated wiring, product library/scanner/Subsonic code, and many tests to emulate another revision. Those task-specific backports must not be hidden in the environment.

milestone_003_sub-02:end.rationale: The owner delta comments product event behavior and changes generated wiring plus repository mocks. Cross-SIF consensus preserves the actual post-hoist endpoint semantics.

milestone_003_sub-03:start.rationale: The owner delta disables plugin tests, adds a product broker method, and changes mock signatures solely for compatibility. It is not task-neutral Docker setup.

milestone_003_sub-03:end.rationale: The owner delta only disables two tests and therefore improperly shrinks the endpoint test state.

milestone_003_sub-04:start.rationale: The owner delta disables tests and rewrites mock and test call signatures; the retained merged node must use its clean entry tree.

milestone_006:start.rationale: The owner delta adds build-ignore directives to eighty tests. This is the mass test deletion explicitly excluded from the unified environment.

milestone_006:end.rationale: The same eighty-test suppression appears at END, so it contributes no milestone semantics and destroys consistent regression coverage.

milestone_007:start.rationale: The owner delta only disables agents_plugin_test.go; the clean consensus keeps the test visible at START.
